verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs say platforms can hold funds in users' balance accounts until payout (docs-2, docs-9). Release can follow Adyen's managed payout schedules or custom payouts that give you full control over timing (docs-3, docs-12, docs-20, docs-23), and chargeback-handling options cover the dispute side (docs-11, docs-24). This covers the core hold-then-release-on-my-trigger story. Missing for 10: documented escrow-like hold limits (maximum hold duration, regulatory or balance caps), explicit guidance on delivery-event-triggered release, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
